 Satire: Clavicular tours the Pentagon
 With impeachment looming, Hegseth inspires troops to mog 
 By LFS , Collegian Correspondent 
 November 16, 2026 
 Warning: The article below is satire and may include sensitive subject matter. It may not be suitable for all readers. 
 This past weekend, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth welcomed “looksmaxxing” influencer Braden Peters to the Pentagon. Peters, who is better known by his internet persona, Clavicular, received a private tour of the Department of War headquarters and delivered a brief address to military and civilian personnel.
 The tour visited the Hall of Heroes and the Soldiers and Signers of the Constitution Corridor before concluding with a visit to the Heroes of America Memorial, located at the site of the Sept. 11, 2001, terror attack on the Pentagon. While surveying the memorial, which honors the victims of American Airlines Flight 77, Peters reportedly commented mournfully on the plane’s negative canthal tilt.
 Peters then gave a short speech to an audience of Pentagon employees and the press, including Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, a former hedge fund manager known for his exceptionally long philtrum.
 The influencer opened with commentary on Hegseth’s new policy requiring mandatory testosterone tests for male service members 30 and older. In a halting monotone, Peters lamented the “malformed” audience and expressed support for government-mandated “hardmaxxing.”
 “It doesn’t matter how many battles you win,” Peters continued. “The real race is not to develop nuclear weapons or artificial intelligence, but to ascend.”
 When Peters concluded, members of Hegseth’s new Religious Affairs Office gave the influencer a standing ovation.
 When asked about his reaction to the pending sexual assault charges against Peters, Hegseth said he didn’t have “a molecule of faith” in the charges. He continued to demean the reporter, referring to her as a “foid” and scolding her colleagues for “jestergooning.”
 According to sources, the press briefing concluded abruptly after Peters told Hegseth he had “prey eyes.”
 LFS is The Brick’s Department of War correspondent. She can be reached at [email protected] .
